serviceCredential.reason: The raw credential is retained only in a mode-0600 temporary file until the Commerce Core revision is deployed and read/cross-tenant verification completes. Render stores only the SHA-256 hash, prefix, and expiry.

implementation.bootstrapBehavior: Render receives only a SHA-256 hash and prefix; the raw credential is intended for Vercel Preview only; Core creates the principal through app.create_service_principal with an audit event.

verification.negativeCrossTenantCoverage: existing agent isolation suites plus tenant/shop-scoped principal test

decision.nextRequiredAction: Merge and deploy the revision containing the staging principal bootstrap, then verify scoped reads and cross-tenant rejection before clearing bootstrap metadata and the temporary credential file.
